title: Cylinder embeddings and residual Haar projection are compatible through the Gaussian tower

hilbert_limit.embedding: J_NM f=f composed with pi_MN is an isometry from L2(gamma_N) to L2(gamma_M), and J_NL=J_ML J_NM
hilbert_limit.adjoint: J_NM star is conditional expectation over the new coordinates; J_NM J_NM star is the orthogonal projection onto the first-N cylinder subspace
hilbert_limit.limit: The completed inductive limit is canonically L2(gamma_infinity), because finite-coordinate cylinder functions are dense by martingale convergence
hilbert_limit.circle_action: An integer charge on each complex coordinate plane defines a coordinatewise measure-preserving U(1) action; its L2 representation is strongly continuous because continuity holds on dense cylinders and the operators are unitary
hilbert_limit.haar_compatibility: Charge-stable cutoffs intertwine U_N(theta), so J_NM P_N=P_M J_NM and E_N P_infinity=P_N E_N
hilbert_limit.boundary: The construction quantizes the declared Gaussian cylinder algebra and residual compact projection only; it neither selects the charge sequence nor proves equivalence to a source physical representation
